title: nb: superseding a pending or rejected node moves it straight to superseded
body:
Found in the spec-vs-code review of branch `worktree-agent-af4147e78b41b3bce` on 2026-11-09. Line numbers are that branch.

SPEC (Rules enforced on write): a pending goal, conclusion, lead or decision leaves `pending` only through `nb confirm` or `nb reject`.

`establish` in `bin/nb` (line 719) sets any superseded-by target to `superseded` unless it already is. A reviewer reproduced it: a user `nb add goal --link supersedes:<pending> --link supersedes:<rejected>` turned both into `superseded`.

Decide whether to refuse the link, or to allow it and say so in the spec.
